data.name: Bathe in Light
data.oracle_text: Radiance — Choose a color. Target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it gain protection from the chosen color until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: "Truth shines even in darkness. Those who march on the side of truth walk always in righteous light."

data.name: Brightflame
data.oracle_text: Radiance — Brightflame deals X damage to target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.
data.flavor_text:
"Let the pyres of the unbelievers light our way."
—Razia

data.name: Cleansing Beam
data.oracle_text: Radiance — Cleansing Beam deals 2 damage to target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it.
data.flavor_text:
"Justice is toothless without punishment. Righteousness cannot succeed without the suffering of the guilty."
—Razia, Boros archangel

data.name: Incite Hysteria
data.oracle_text: Radiance — Until end of turn, target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it gain "This creature can't block."
data.flavor_text:
"The Boros say they want to bring order to Ravnica. Funny then, how well they use chaos."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

data.name: Leave No Trace
data.oracle_text: Radiance — Destroy target enchantment and each other enchantment that shares a color with it.
data.flavor_text: The magic of the Boros patrols the streets even when their soldiers do not.

data.name: Rally the Righteous
data.oracle_text: Radiance — Untap target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it. Those creatures get +2/+0 until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: Yuri took up the ragged Boros banner, and his brethren, inspired by the act, followed him back into the fight.

data.name: Surge of Zeal
data.oracle_text: Radiance — Target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it gain haste until end of turn.
data.flavor_text:
"If only my poxes were as infectious as their zealotry."
—Savra

data.name: Wojek Apothecary
data.oracle_text: Radiance — {T}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it this turn.
data.flavor_text: "A few arrows aren't enough to pierce your faith, soldier. You'll be back on the battlefield by sun's dawn."

data.name: Wojek Embermage
data.oracle_text: Radiance — {T}: This creature deals 1 damage to target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it.
data.flavor_text: "Your brother's crimes are your crimes. You stood by and lent support, so you too must face judgment."

data.name: Wojek Siren
data.oracle_text: Radiance — Target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it get +1/+1 until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: It is the call to arms, the call to fury, the call to blood.
